allowed_implementation_freedom: Internal language types, module boundaries, algorithms, and storage are unconstrained when every cited observable distinction is preserved.
Exact diagnostic wording and ordering are unconstrained unless a cited authority explicitly requires them.
canonical_input_forms: repository root and exact repository-relative path
non_normative_behaviors: Python object types, exception classes, module layout, and incidental algorithms are not semantic authority.
Rust crate, module, and internal type layout are not semantic authority.
required_state_distinctions: a nonempty relative path resolving inside the repository is accepted
a path resolving outside the repository is rejected
a symlink resolving to a contained target is accepted while an escaping symlink is rejected
title: ADR repository path containment
